name: WildGrass
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.409

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven sparse_grass (2x2, long dry-strawed grass) with patches of ambientCG Grass001 and Poly Haven leafy_grass at true scale, plus modelled-and-baked plant decals (plantain, dandelion, clover, dry leaves and straw); darker and rougher than MeadowTurf
known_weaknesses: third pass: tussock relief and more straw make it rougher, but it is lumpy pasture, not long grass: length must come from 3D tufts
